title: Gallaudet co-writes the Bluegill Triple Prime report
place_text: Bluegill Triple Prime nuclear test site

tellings.quote: I helped Jeff Krookchank write the report on it.

plain: Tim Gallaudet, a retired US Navy admiral, says he helped a man named Jeff Krookchank write a report on Bluegill Triple Prime, a US nuclear test carried out in 1962 near Johnston Atoll, a small island in the Pacific. He mentions it as part of his own first-hand work, in a conversation about unexplained objects in and over the ocean.
